labelling.why: The owner asked Claude Code to finish the 50-post check itself.
labelling.textUsed: Company-board posts (10): the full post text from the board's public API, the same text as the public post. Adzuna posts (40): the API snippet (up to 500 characters) with the title, company and location. adzuna.in refuses automated requests, so the full Adzuna pages were not read.
labelling.blind: Labelled from a pack built from the raw collected posts, with no tags or predictions in it. eval/pred_50.json was not opened before this file and eval/labels_50.csv were committed.
limits: Not a hand check: an AI model made every label.
The same AI session wrote the tagging prompt and the guideline, so the labels are not independent of the design.
For the 40 Adzuna posts the labeller saw only the snippet the tagger saw, so facts that appear only in the full post are not checked.
